With nothing left to do for Mirathorn, the group loads up the wagon and continues north, all the while a gigantic storm from the west appears to be merging with a storm coming from the south. Most of the day is spent quietly traveling. Thrin asks Ephanna whether or not the forest can lie, which he is informed it does, while this breaks Caelynn out of her silent contemplation long enough to comment that people lie too; with a glance towards Lysandra. While walking along the wagon Karsemine notices something odd happening when birds fly over: something is wrong with the reflections in the puddles. It appears that the reflections are somewhat delayed, anything reflected in the shimmering water

The group continues on when they see a cloud of dust as something is moving fast in their direction. They soon encounter a young rider on a horse at top speed. She slows long enough to say that they cannot stop unless they have food for her horse so that she can continue on. The horse has clearly been running at full speed for a long time and could use a short break. Caeylynn conjures some Good Berries for the horse and fetches some water. Stafl immediately recognizes the soldier’s uniform of the Elderwild Reach, the same uniform he wore before leaving and joining this group. The woman introduces herself as Private Hester and she is carrying a sealed tube in her hand with reports for Miratho
The party broke camp north of Mossford and pushed toward Mireward under worsening weather.

- Storm fronts made the first march day tense; we need to plan the next weather roll beat for Session 23. - Hester Mull appeared as a courier encounter; unresolved whether the party trusts the detour offer.
